card.line: Lehi was a town in Judah where Samson, helped by the Spirit of the LORD, defeated the Philistines, and where God gave him water when he was thirsty.

moments.title: Philistines camp at Lehi
moments.text: The Philistines went up into Judah and camped near Lehi to arrest Samson. Three thousand men of Judah then bound Samson with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.

moments.title: Samson breaks free
moments.text: When Samson arrived in Lehi, the Philistines came out shouting against him. The Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the ropes broke loose from his hands. He took a fresh donkey's jawbone and struck down a thousand men.

moments.title: Water from the hollow place
moments.text: Samson was very thirsty and cried out to the LORD. God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out. When Samson drank, his strength returned, and he named the spring En-hakkore.
